title: On shed
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：on　|　正文 339 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 on 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the foreman kept the rope ① on Monday morning at the ramp, and everybody in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of that morning: the rope had been left ② on the wall of the shed, and nobody had asked a single question. The foreman had come to the site two shifts earlier and spoke little of the site he had left behind him.

The sheet for May 1951 puts it plainer. It was done ③ on purpose, and the worker who kept the rope had lifted it ④ on the word of the doctor twice before the winter came; nothing in the site was ever done on purpose in those days. The worker wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every shift thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far ramp, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ on account of the rain, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ on the advice of the old nurse; he was not a man who explained himself, and the site had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the sheet. What the line asked for was that the rope be lifted ⑦ on the back of a cart, and that the names be written ⑧ on the cover of the almanac. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried on the back of a cart.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967 she kept the rope ⑨ on Monday morning again when nobody else would, and ⑩ on the wall of the shed, she said in 1969, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the rope in the same ramp for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the site never forgot what had been done on the wall of the shed.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…上（表时间：on Monday morning）
B. prep. 在…上（表处所：on the wall of the shed）
C. prep. 在（某日）（表方式／状态：on purpose）
D. prep. 在（某日）（引出施动者或相关的人：be lifted on the word of the doctor）
E. prep. 在…上（表原因：on account of the rain）
F. prep. 在（某日）（表对象／目的：on the advice of the old nurse）
G. prep. 在…上（表工具／材料：on the back of a cart）
H. prep. 在（某日）（表载体／处所：written on the cover of the almanac）

items.q: on the wall of the shed
on the word of the doctor
on the advice of the old nurse
on the back of a cart
on the cover of the almanac
on the wall of the shed, she said

answers.why: on 意为“在…上”，此处引出时间 Monday morning（周一早晨），说明那件短短的绳索是在何时留下的。
on 意为“在…上”，此处引出处所 the wall of the shed（棚屋的墙上），说明东西被放在何处。
on 意为“在（某日）”，此处引出方式或状态 purpose（故意），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
on 意为“在（某日）”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 大夫的话：be lifted on the word of the doctor。
on 意为“在…上”，此处引出原因 account of the rain（因为下雨），说明整件事由何而起。
on 意为“在（某日）”，此处引出对象或目的 the advice of the old nurse（老护士的劝告）。
on 意为“在…上”，此处引出工具或材料 the back of a cart（一辆车的车板）。
on 意为“在（某日）”，此处引出载体 the cover of the almanac（历书的封面上）：names written on the cover of the almanac。
on 意为“在…上”，1967 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件短短的绳索，此处仍引出时间 Monday morning。
on 意为“在…上”，母亲 1969 年那句话引出的仍是那一处棚屋的墙上。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年周一早晨前后，工头把那件短短的绳索留在了坡台。（on Monday morning）
那件短短的绳索被放在棚屋的墙上，谁也没有过问。（on the wall of the shed）
整件事是故意做成的，施工单上写得明白。（on purpose）
入冬之前，那件短短的绳索已经由大夫的话抬过两回。（be lifted on the word of the doctor）
叔叔说，整件事是由因为下雨起的。（on account of the rain）
他说，家里从来没有人为老护士的劝告做过这件事。（on the advice of the old nurse）
answers: In 1957 the foreman kept the rope on Monday morning at the ramp.
The rope had been left on the wall of the shed, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done on purpose, or so the sheet says.
The rope had been lifted on the word of the doctor twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun on account of the rain.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it on the advice of the old nurse.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 on 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the foreman kept the rope on Monday morning, and nobody forgot it.
The rope had been left on the wall of the shed for three shifts.
The work was done on purpose, as it always was in those days.
The rope had been lifted on the word of the doctor twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the rope on Monday morning again when nobody else would.
The whole site never forgot what had been done on the wall of the shed.
